# Windy Hair Salon Original

> Korean hair salon based in Austin, Texas. Windy and Min specialize in Korean digital perms, down perms and cuts that settle in soft and natural, from a cozy private studio on Burnet Road.

- Phone: (737) 400-2334
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Pflugerville, Round Rock
- Yelp rating: 4.5 from 128 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/windy-hair-salon-original/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/windy-hair-salon-original/book.html

## Services
- Digital perms: Korean digital perms for soft, natural-looking curls and waves.
- Men's perms & cuts: Textured men's perms, down perms and Asian men's cuts.
- Cuts: Precision cuts for women and men.
- Color: Color and toning to finish the look.

## About
Windy Hair Salon Original is Windy's Korean hair studio, now in a private suite at 7301 Burnet Road after years near the airport. She works alongside stylist Min. Clients come from across Austin for digital perms, men's perms, Asian men's cuts and color. They say the team checks in through every step, explains what to expect, and cares more about the result than the upsell.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment at Windy Hair Salon Original?
  A: Appointments are best. Call (737) 400-2334 or book online and Windy will confirm by text.
- Q: Where is Windy Hair Salon Original?
  A: 7301 Burnet Rd, Ste 106, Studio 23, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: Do you cut and color all hair types?
  A: Yes. Women's, men's and kids' cuts, color, highlights and styling for every hair type.
- Q: Can I bring inspiration photos?
  A: Please do. Photos help your stylist match the cut or color you have in mind.
- Q: What do clients say about Windy?
  A: Windy Hair Salon Original is rated 4.5 stars from 128 Yelp reviews. Clients mention natural-looking digital perms, careful check-ins and a cozy studio.
